reviewFindings: P1: popup/main.ts:20 + background.ts:63 + content.ts:14 - runtime.sendMessage fans out to background and all content scripts -> double fill in active tab, unintended fills in other tabs, and popup status race (often shows 'Filled 0 fields'); fix by having popup use tabs.sendMessage to the active tab and/or tag popup->background messages the content script ignores.

P2: orchestrate.ts:194-195 - 'paragraph' branch returns 2-4 untrimmed sentences and never consults effectiveMaxLen; <textarea maxlength=40> (AE4) is over-filled; route textareas through dummyText(effectiveMaxLen).
P2: rng.ts:int - Math.round(span/step) lets int(0,10,4) return 12>max; number/range can exceed bounds (R10); use Math.floor and clamp to [min,max].
P2: fillers.ts:fillRadio - radio group queried on ownerDocument; multiple forms sharing a radio name only fill the first form (R1/R10); scope to el.form ?? closest('form').
P2: rules-ui.ts:validateRule vs rules.ts:matchRule - urlPattern-only rules validate but matchRule returns false when conditions.length===0; silently dead rules (R16/R17); align the two.
P2: detect.ts:describeField - desc.label is never resolved (<label for>/wrapping label/aria-labelledby); label match attribute is dead in detect + rules (R9/R16); resolve label text in describeField.

P2: orchestrate.ts:fillCurrentForm - relies on document.activeElement with no element passed from popup/context-menu; frequently resolves to <html> and fills the whole page (R2); remember last-focused field or pass the clicked target.
P3: rules.ts:saveRules/loadRules - sync->local fallback leaves stale sync rules+meta while loadRules prefers sync; clear sync on local fallback.
P3: detect.ts:mapType - datetime-local/month/time/week map to 'date' and receive invalid YYYY-MM-DD; generate per-type format or skip.
P3: orchestrate.ts:fillOne - confirmation copy uses last value field (not same-type source) and state spans all forms; confirm can copy wrong value (R12); track per-type last value.
P3: detect.ts:detectType - data-fake hint returned verbatim; camelCase generator names (firstName) miss snake_case generateValue (R9); normalize hints.
P3: fillers.ts:fillSelect - sets el.value (no-op for <select multiple>); never fills multiple selects (R10); set option.selected.
P3: settings.ts:isIgnoredOrigin - literal domains compiled as unanchored regex (/example.com/ matches example_com); escape literals (R4).
P3: text.ts:clipToWordBoundary - returns a mid-word slice when budget < first token (R7/AE4); return a whole word or empty.
P3: settings.ts:mergeDefaults - non-array stored list fields survive and make matchesAny throw; coerce to arrays in merge/migrate (U5).
